typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DB_NAME as string (),
	DB_PASSWORD as string (),
	DB_USER_NAME as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileSource as string (),
	FOLDER_PATH as string (),
	gv_OraclePassword as string (),
	gv_OracleProvider as string (),
	gv_OracleUserID as string (),
	gv_SqlServerProvider as string (),
	gv_strOracleDS as string (),
	SERVER_NAME as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Column 0} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive({Column 0} = {Column 0}) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		FILE_BODY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		FILE_BODY = {Copy of Column 0})) ~> OLEDBDestination
